title: PJM Messages Public Web Service response
description: Derived by API Evangelist from the verbatim live response of GET https://messages.pjm.com/messages/rest/public/messages (Accept: application/json), captured 2026-07-27 and saved at examples/pjm-messages-public-response.json. PJM publishes no schema for this endpoint; field names, types and null-ability are taken only from the observed payload, so fields that were empty or null in that capture are typed permissively rather than guessed.

messages.description: Current PJM tool/website planned-change and impact notices, the same set rendered on https://www.pjm.com/markets-and-operations/etools/upcoming-changes

message.description: Notice body as pre-rendered HTML, including inline style attributes.

messageRaw.description: Notice body as authored HTML, without PJM's presentation wrapper.

appearanceFlag.description: Whether the notice is currently displayed.

blockAccessFlag.description: Whether the notice corresponds to an access-blocking event.

effectiveDate.description: Epoch milliseconds at which the notice becomes effective.

terminateDate.description: Epoch milliseconds at which the notice expires.

applications.description: Human-readable names of the affected PJM tools/applications.

applicationIds.description: PJM numeric identifiers of the affected applications, positionally aligned with applications.

sortedApplications.description: The applications list in PJM's display order.

changeStart.description: Epoch milliseconds for the start of the change window.

changeEnd.description: Epoch milliseconds for the end of the change window.

changeDuration.description: Duration of impact. Null in the captured response; type left permissive because no populated example was observed.

messageActions.description: Actions required of the reader, e.g. 'No action required/information only', 'Please share within your organization'.

messageImpacts.description: Impact descriptors. Empty in the captured response; item type not asserted because no populated example was observed.
